description_en: Queries the results of an operation on a stack group
description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询指定资源栈组操作的结果列表详情
name: ListStackGroupOperationResults

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the stack group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组所属的地域ID。  
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查询最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the operation.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151342.html operation to query the operation ID
parameters.help_zh:
操作ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151342.html获取操作ID
parameters.name: operation_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。  

取值范围：1~50。
  
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的页码。  

起始值：1。
  
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

StackGroupOperationResults.description_en: The details of the results of the operation

AccountId.description_en:
The ID of the account to which the stack instance belongs.

If the stack group has self-managed permissions, the stack instance belongs to an Alibaba Cloud account.

If the stack group has service-managed permissions, the stack instance belongs to a member account in the resource directory.

For more information about the account, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html）
AccountId.description_zh:
资源栈实例所属目标账号ID。

自助管理权限模式下，该账号是阿里云账号。

服务管理权限模式下，该账号是资源目录的成员账号。

关于目标账号的更多信息，请参见[概览]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html）

RdFolderId.description_en:
The folder ID of the resource directory.

This parameter is returned only when the stack group is granted service-managed permissions
RdFolderId.description_zh:
资源目录的资源夹ID。
仅限使用服务管理权限模式的资源栈组，才会返回该参数

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the stack instance

Status.description_en:
The status of the operation.

Valid values:

RUNNING: The operation is being performed.

SUCCEEDED: The operation succeeded.

FAILED: The operation failed.

STOPPING: The operation is being stopped.

STOPPED: The operation is stopped
Status.description_zh:
执行状态。

取值：  

PENDING：操作等待中。 

RUNNING：操作进行中。

SUCCEEDED：操作成功。

FAILED：操作失败。

CANCELLED：操作已取消

StatusReason.description_en:
The reason why the operation is in a specific state.

This parameter is returned only when stack instances are in the OUTDATED state
StatusReason.description_zh:
状态原因描述。

仅当资源栈实例状态为已过期（OUTDATED）时，才会返回该参数
